title: Return-policy generosity by retailer familiarity
statement:
Return-policy generosity is not equally valuable in every context: lesser-known retailers can benefit more from generous policies for products with high return effort, while well-known retailers benefit more where return effort is low. (IDEAS/RePEc)

Options:
- Generous + credibility: generous-returns-plus-brand-proof (fits: less known brand, high return effort, high consideration)
- Free return shipping: free-return-shipping (fits: physical returns, high effort, friction reducing)
- Extended window: extended-return-window (fits: considered purchase, uncertainty reducing, less known brand)
- Standard clear policy: standard-return-policy-with-clear-terms (fits: well known brand, low return effort, low clutter)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, online retail, fashion, consumer goods. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: Increasing customer purchase intention through product return policies: The pivotal impacts of retailer brand familiarity and product categories
source.venue: Journal of Retailing and Consumer Services
